title: Timeboxing
summary: Timeboxing assigns a fixed period to one outcome, making scope and stopping points visible. Leave short buffers between demanding blocks.

title: Meeting agendas
summary: A useful agenda names the desired decisions, assigns a facilitator, provides pre-reading, and timeboxes each topic.

title: Task prioritization
summary: A simple priority system weighs impact, urgency, effort, and dependencies. Keep the active list small and review it regularly.

title: Effective email
summary: Clear email leads with the requested action, supplies only necessary context, names a deadline when real, and uses a specific subject line.

title: Weekly review
summary: A weekly review captures loose commitments, updates calendars and tasks, checks upcoming deadlines, and chooses a few outcomes for the next week.
